provenance.method: Exact unchanged native Word paragraph boundary, one changed sentence and equal adjacent sentences; same frozen two-scale rule. Re-encoding only, no selection based on scores.
provenance.new_controls: Per work, one same-source genuine donor sentence substitution and unchanged negative. Unchanged pairs abstain before scoring.
provenance.new_panel: Ten earlier PLOS Biology CC BY 4.0 source works and previously qualified synthetic one-sentence edits. For the native Word test, a single deliberate boundary precedes/follows the known target according to low-bit parity of SHA-256 of DOI.
provenance.older_panel: Every previously eligible 22 earlier-draft case re-encoded from the existing TXT source, including 12 known edits, 8 ordinary revisions, 2 calibration cases.
provenance.release_gate: At least two useful edits from distinct PLOS works, at most one ordinary group and no changed prior decisions. All exact geometries, PDF/JSON and source replay must verify.

scope: Native Word drafts with one changed English sentence, identical immediate neighbors and one preserved adjacent Word body paragraph boundary.
